name: Tip Tracker: Server Income
description:
Know what you really make. Tip Tracker is a private tip tracker and shift log for people who work for tips. Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash, card — and see your real hourly rate the moment you save it.

WHAT IT DOES
Most apps stop at "how much did you make tonight". This tip tracker answers the harder question: what did that shift actually pay you per hour, after you tipped out? Enter your hours and your server tips, add your tip-out and your base wage, and it does the arithmetic you would otherwise be doing in your head at 1am.

• Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash tips, card tips, tip-out
• Your effective hourly rate: base wage + tips − tip-out, over hours worked
• Track income by shift, by week and by month
• Watch your hourly rate trend across shifts as one smoothed line
• Find your best nights — which shifts actually pay, by day of the week
• A full income history you can browse as a list or on a calendar
• More than one job, each with its own wage and its own numbers
• Export your shift log as a CSV whenever you want it
• Optional tip percentage, if you log your sales

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add where you work, and your base wage if you get one.
2. At the end of the night, open the app and enter your hours and your tips.
3. Save. You immediately see what you kept and what it worked out to per hour.
4. Come back next shift. Two shifts in, you can compare them.

THE AFTER-MIDNIGHT RULE
A shift that ends at 1:40am belongs to the night that started yesterday. Between midnight and 6am this tip log files a new entry under the previous day automatically — so your week totals, your income tracker and your day-of-week stats stay right without you thinking about it. The date is always editable.

WHY THE HOURLY RATE
Two hundred dollars is a great night on a five-hour Friday and an ordinary one on a twelve-hour double. Totals alone can't tell you which shifts to ask for, which sections pay, or whether the new schedule is actually better. An hourly rate can. That is why this server tip tracker leads with the rate on every screen and draws the trend of it over time.

YOUR HISTORY, KEPT PROPERLY
Every shift you log stays. Browse your server tips as a running list or as a month calendar where the busier nights sit darker, so a season's shape is visible at a glance. Weekly and monthly summaries add up hours, tips and what you kept, and each one carries its own rate so you can compare a slow February against a good July honestly. Nothing expires and nothing is trimmed.

WHO IT IS FOR
Servers and waitresses. Bartenders and barbacks. Baristas, hosts and bussers. Delivery drivers and couriers. Hair stylists, barbers and nail techs. Valets, bellhops, casino dealers, catering and banquet staff. Anyone whose income arrives as tips and whose paycheck never tells the whole story.

A REAL INCOME LOG, FASTER THAN A SPREADSHEET
Built for a phone in a server station, not a desk. Every number in this income tracker is one you typed: nothing is estimated, nothing is averaged against other people, and nothing is filled in for you. The tip log adds it up and shows you the result — that's the whole product.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Your data stays on your device — no account, no cloud. There is no sign-in and no server, so your shift log works with no signal at all: a basement bar, a walk-in, a parking garage. Your shifts are never uploaded anywhere. No ads, ever.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Your shifts, your jobs, your rates and your whole history live in one app that opens instantly and works anywhere. Pick up a second job and its numbers stay separate from the first. Export a CSV of your own records whenever you want one — it is your data and it stays yours. This shift log is quick enough to fill in while you are cashing out, and detailed enough that it still makes sense a year later when you are looking back at a whole season of server tips.

For your personal records only — not tax, accounting, or financial advice.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Staff & Groups — add employees, assign roles, and group them (servers, bar, kitchen, support). Bulk import from a spreadsheet if you're switching over.

Shifts — build shifts from templates or on the fly. Import daily sales sheets or tip totals so you're not retyping POS numbers.

Settlements — run a settlement for any shift. Tip+ shows the source tips, the formula, and the per-person breakdown. Nothing hidden.

Audit Logs — every edit, every settlement, every override is captured so nothing gets quietly changed after the fact.

Multi-location — run more than one restaurant from a single account and switch in one tap.

Languages — English and Simplified Chinese.

BUILT FOR THE MESSY REALITY

Split shifts, mid-shift role changes, a bartender who covered a section for an hour, a no-show, a comp that changes the tip pool — Tip+ handles the awkward stuff without breaking the audit trail. Because that's the actual job.

WHY TIP+

• Fair — every split is transparent and the math is visible.
• Fast — close a shift in minutes.
• Flexible — your rules, not ours.
• Trustworthy — full audit log so staff and owners both know the numbers weren't fudged.

PRIVACY

name: Tip+: Hotel Tip Collection
description:
Tip+ Hotel Tip Collection is the tipping companion for hotel housekeeping and service staff. Scan a room's QR code, claim the tip a guest left for you, and see your earnings in real time.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Your hotel places a small QR code in every room.
2. Guests scan the code with their phone camera and leave a tip through a secure payment page — no cash, no envelopes.
3. When you finish cleaning or servicing the room, open Tip+ and scan the same QR code. The tip is instantly credited to you.

If two of you worked the room together, split it evenly in one tap.

FEATURES

• Scan-to-claim — Instantly claim the tip in the room you just serviced.
• Solo or split — Claim on your own, or split by parts with coworkers who helped.
• Report duplicates — If someone else already claimed a room, flag it in one tap.
• My tips — Every room you cleaned today, with a running total.
• Statements — Review past pay periods based on your hotel's settlement cycle (weekly, semi-monthly, or monthly), plus your current unsettled balance.
• Secure sign-in — Access with the email and password your hotel provisions for you.

TRANSPARENT AND FAIR

Every dollar of tip goes to the staff who earned it. Guests pay all processing fees on top of the tip, so the amount you see in the app is the amount you actually take home. All claims are time-stamped and visible to your hotel manager, so there's no confusion about who claimed which room.

GETTING STARTED

You'll need an account from your hotel employer. Ask your manager or owner to add you — they'll send a link to set your password. Once you're signed in, you'll see the rooms assigned to you and can start scanning.

Are you a hotel owner or manager? Visit https://tipplus.org to set up your property, invite staff, and print room QR codes.

PRIVACY AND PAYMENTS

• Your account is tied to your hotel and never sees data from other properties.
• We never sell or share your personal data.
• All payments are processed by Stripe, a global industry-standard payment provider.

SUPPORT

For help, contact your hotel manager or reach out through https://tipplus.org.

◼ Calendar

◼ Pomodoro Mode
Enjoy better focus and productivity by trying out the Pomodoro technique, thanks to our built-in Pomodoro mode.

The idea behind the Pomodoro technique is that you can work more effectively when you work in timed, 25-minute increments (with breaks in between). Our Pomodoro timer automatically tracks your time in 25-minute increments, with notifications, a full screen mode, and countdown timer to really help you stay focused and on task.

◼ Favorites
Favorites allows you to create shortcuts to frequently used time entries. Start tracking time on a favorite time entry with one tap.

◼ Notifications
Enable notifications so that you always know if & what are you tracking (or if you're not tracking anything!), and always be aware where does your time go.

Organize and add more details to your time entries by adding projects, clients and tags. Clearly see where your work hours go and adjust your precious time & routines accordingly.

◼ Shortcuts
By using @ and #, you can quickly add those projects and tags much faster and get back to work right away!

◼ Widgets
Place a Toggl Track widget on your Home Screen to see your timer running — and to start or stop a time entry.

◼ Sync
Your time is safe with us - phone, desktop or web, your time is seamlessly synced and kept safe between all of your devices.

◼ Manual Mode
Want more control? Add and edit all of your time manually and make sure that every second of your time is accounted for. This feature is optional and it's accessible from the Settings menu.

◽ But what if I'm offline?
No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync with your account (and the rest of your devices) - your time (and money!) is not going anywhere.

◽ Is the app free?
Yes, Toggl Track for Android is completely free for you to use. Not only that, there are no ads at all - ever!

◽ Can I send you some feedback?
You betcha (and we'd love to hear from you)! You can send us feedback directly from the app - look for the 'Submit Feedback' in the Settings menu.

And that's Toggl Track - a time tracker so simple that you'll actually use it and get things done! Track important tasks, use reports to see how you spend your time and boost your productivity. Whether you are at an office, in commute, stuck on a space mission to Mars or just want to see how much time you're wasting on projects that aren't bringing you money - track your time anywhere you go!

Every business has different needs, which is why ExpenseOnDemand has been designed to be highly configurable. Choose from over 100 functions.

ExpenseOnDemand has been designed to ensure compliance with GST, VAT, sales tax, etc.

Credit card expenses:

Support for multiple currencies:
Recording business travel expense during overseas trips is really easy with ExpenseOnDemand, as it supports multiple currencies such as US Dollar, Euro, Pound Sterling, etc.

ExpenseOnDemand business expense tracker app works with world’s top accounting systems such as Tally, Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, etc. That apart, our Open APIs can connect to any HR, Payroll, Accounting or CRM application to exchange data.

Log income. Know what to set aside. Never miss a deadline. Built on the

FREE FOREVER — no trial, no card:

• Year overview with paid/upcoming status

PREMIUM — pay the least you legally can, and know what April holds:
• What to set aside from each payment — the real tax it causes, not a
flat rule. Past the Social Security cap the rate drops sharply
• What April looks like: safe harbor stops the penalty, not the bill. We
show it building on income you have already been paid
• Your household: a spouse's salary, withholding and a retirement
contribution each move what you owe by thousands
• Your state's tax folded into every quarterly figure
• The state rules that change what you owe: some split the year unevenly,
and the income at which they start asking varies
• Income by client — the fastest way to check that every 1099-NEC you
expected has arrived
• Retirement room: your SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) limits from your own
profit, and what each contribution takes off the bill. A solo 401(k)
usually allows far more than a SEP
• A year-end PDF for your accountant: income by client, every payment
with its confirmation number, estimated vs actual
• CSV export as a real file you can share
• A home screen widget with your number and the countdown

We add a state only after checking its rules against that state's own tax
agency. Every income-tax state except Connecticut is covered — 40 states plus
DC. If yours is not, the app says so and does not charge you for it. Some states do not ask
individuals for quarterly payments at all, and we say that instead of
showing you deadlines that do not exist.

Every federal figure and date comes from these public IRS pages and is
rechecked every December. Deadlines follow the IRS rule for weekends and
holidays and are checked against every date the IRS has published since 2016.

Due dates, rate schedules and standard deductions — Form 1040-ES:
https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-1040-es

Who has to pay, and the $1,000 federal threshold:
https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/estimated-taxes

https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc306

The 2026 brackets and deductions — Rev. Proc. 2025-32:
https://www.irs.gov/irb/2025-45_IRB

State deadlines come from each state's own tax agency; the IRS directory:
https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/state-government-websites

Everything stays on your device — no account, no bank login, and none of
your tax data leaves your phone.

Sole traders and self-employed professionals who need a mileage log book for tax deductions. Freelancers and contractors tracking business travel. Small business owners managing vehicle expenses. Delivery drivers, sales reps, consultants, tradespeople, and anyone who drives for work. Employees claiming mileage reimbursement from their employer.

🔧 KEY FEATURES:

Quick trip logging with business/personal categories. Automatic mileage rate calculations with tiered rates. PDF and CSV report export. Multiple vehicle support with photos. Dashboard with total km/miles, trips, and claimable amount. Financial year awareness with custom date ranges. Dark mode. Backup and restore. Works offline — no internet required. One-time purchase — no subscription.

Download LogBook today and take control of your mileage tracking. Stop losing deductions. Start logging trips.

TripTracker is able to connect directly to your car so that it can read the odometer and calculate the distance traveled. This allows TripTracker to write your mileage logbook 100% synchronized with your car. In addition, various parameters and the error memory can be read.

TripTracker provides complete and correct data collection. The mileage logbook’s integrity is ensured by various hash and encryption algorithm. In contrary to most other systems all the collected data is your property. It is not stored somewhere abroad on a Server or a Cloud. The mileage logbook is on your phone in a local high performance SQL database.
TripTracker does not sell or analyze your mileage logbook!!

TripTracker has a powerful synchronization mechanism that allows you to collect and edit your mileage logbook across multiple devices. There is also a web interface which allows you to analyze your data on a PC or Mac.

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

Bridge Scale Axle Calculation – Instantly compute steering, drive, and trailer weights as you roll over bridge scales

Tandem Hole Guidance – Get recommendations for sliding trailer tandems to the correct hole after scaling

Fuel Optimizer – Know exactly how much fuel to add or burn to stay within legal truck axle weight limits

Wind Advisor – Receive safety tips for lighter loads in windy conditions

State Weight Limit Info – Access up-to-date regulations across U.S. states

Estimate axle weights using payload from the Bill of Lading and load arrangement—no scale required

name: Drivers' Hours: HGV & Van
description:
Plan your day against EU 561/2006 drivers' hours and UK Working Time (RTD 2005) rules — in real time, on your phone, with no subscription.

Built for both classic HGV work and the newer 2.5–3.5t international vans now in scope with a tachograph. If you're a courier or delivery driver touching a tacho for the first time, this gives you the same live timers, warnings and correction flow HGV drivers already rely on.

Tap Driving, Rest, Other work or Availability and Drivers' Hours does the maths:

- Countdown to your next 45-minute break (4h30 continuous driving), with 15+30 split breaks handled in the correct order.
- Daily driving left — 9 hours, or 10 hours on your two allowed days a week.
- This week (56h) and rolling two-week (90h) driving left.
- Daily rest and weekly rest deadlines (the 6 x 24-hour rule), counting down.
- Working Time (WTD) hours this week against the 60-hour individual-week limit, with cumulative break reminders (30 min after 6h, 45 min after 9h).
- A 17-week rolling WTD average against the 48-hour limit — most apps don't track this at all.
- Clear amber and red warnings before you run out — plus optional reminders that fire even when the app is closed.

Built for UK drivers: dd/mm/yyyy dates, a 24-hour clock and plain English — not the American mm/dd that other apps get wrong.

Forgot to switch mode? Every change is a single tap to correct on the timeline.

No subscription. A one-off purchase removes ads and unlocks PDF and CSV export of your log. Live status, timers and reminders are always free.

Your driving log stays on your device — no account, no cloud, no card reader, no tachograph download. (The free tier shows ads, which use an advertising identifier.)

Important — please read
This app is a planning aid, not the legal record. Your digital tachograph card and the data downloaded from it remain the only official record of your hours. Figures here are estimates from what you enter and can differ from the tacho analysis. The Working Time 48-hour figure is a rolling average over your last 17 recorded weeks; your employer's fixed reference period (17 weeks, or 26 by agreement) may differ, so treat it as a guide. Always check the tachograph.

For 2.5–3.5t vans: this app is for jobs that are actually in scope of EU 561/2006. It does not create an exemption and it does not replace the legal check on whether the van, route and carriage type require a tachograph.

name: 305 HOS
description:
305 HOS – FMCSA-Compliant ELD App for Truck Drivers

305 HOS is a reliable and easy-to-use Electronic Logging Device (ELD) app designed to help commercial drivers stay compliant with the FMCSA’s Hours of Service (HOS) regulations. Built for simplicity and accuracy, it’s the ideal tool for truckers who need to manage their logs from the road without hassle.

Whether you’re an owner-operator or part of a fleet, 305 HOS gives you full control over your daily logs, ensuring you meet all compliance standards while focusing on what matters most—driving.

FMCSA-compliant app to record driver duty status and meet the following regulations:
-60h/7days or 70h/8days Rules
-34 week restart with latest suspension of two periods 1-5am
-11h daily
-14h onduty (daily)
-Sleeper Berth
-Personal Conveyance
-30 minutes Break
-Location recording for engine on and off, and every 60 minutes if moving
-Mobile device permits duty status changes only when the vehicle is at rest
-Warns driver, visually and/or audibly of any malfunction
-When the truck is stationary for 5 minutes or more, it will default to on-duty not driving and the driver must enter the proper status
-The device (ELD) performs self-test, as well as a self-test at any point upon request of an authorized safety assurance official.

Allows for driver and carrier record edits as well as unauthenticated operation.
Support for Hours of Service September 29th 2020 Hours of Service regulation changes added.

name: TruckingOffice ELD
description:
TruckingOffice ELD is the best choice for all professional drivers that are required to comply with the FMCSA Electronic Log Mandate. It is easy to implement even if you aren't tech savvy. The switch will give you peace of mind and keep you working.

Easy to edit your logs. After you create your logs, sometime things need to be adjusted. All logs are fully editable except driving time per FMCSA guidelines.

Only tracks what is required by FMCSA. When submitting records to the DOT inspection officers the system will submit all required information, but won't send any additional data.

Roadside Inspection - there are three methods of supplying the inspection data to a roadside inspector. You can send via email, send it to the DOT via web service, or you can view the information on your phone.

Simple duty status change. Changing your duty status from the drop down is simple and you can enter comments as needed. Your duty status will automatically change when you start driving, making it automatic for tracking drive time.

Plug and Play - No Installation Required
The VID (vehicle interface device) plugs into the ECM (electronic control module) port on your truck and talks to the TruckingOffice ELD app via blue tooth technology. There is no installation involved. This is a simple plug and play device. You don't have to do any complicated pairing or anything. It just works.

TruckingOffice ELD is an FMCSA Certified ELD provider. Click here to view the list of approved certified ELD providers. https://eld.fmcsa.dot.gov/List

description:

✔ If an employee arrives at work late and works after the company's finish time, the application will calculate overtime by subtracting the amount of time he or she was late.

✔ The total workhour is calculated by subtracting the launch time from the total work hour.

name: Student Gradebook for Teachers
description:
Student Gradebook for Teachers is a secure, offline-first gradebook designed for educators, teachers, and instructors who need a reliable way to manage student records and calculate academic performance. Built to handle complex grading rules entirely on your device, this app streamlines classroom administrative workflows without requiring any internet connection.

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security

Invite a friend from the app and you both get 30 days of Nello+.

A DAY WITH NELLO
Morning: two taps on how the night went. After school: the meltdown that came out of nowhere gets captured as ABC while you still remember it. Bedtime: one win in the jar. None of it takes a minute, because an autism tracker you have to sit down for is one you stop using by Thursday.

BUILT FOR THE PEOPLE WHO ASK "WHY?"
The point of an autism behavior tracker is not the log — it is the pattern underneath it. Nello reads back what you entered: how often the hard moments follow a transition, which triggers and settings come up most, and whether this week was harder or calmer than the weeks before. You stop guessing, and you walk into appointments with one page a professional can read in thirty seconds.

FOR AUTISTIC TEENS AND ADULTS
Self-tracking mode is not an afterthought bolted onto an autism parent app. Log your own sensory load, shutdowns and glimmers in your own words. Nothing frames autistic traits as deficits, and nothing is shared unless you share it.

PRIVACY, PLAINLY
No account, no cloud. Your autism journal and its patterns stay on your phone, and nothing about you or your child is sold or shared.

THE SEARCH TERMS WE WERE BUILT FOR
Autism tracker. Autism behavior tracker. Meltdown tracker. Autism journal. Sensory tracker. ABC behavior tracker. Autism parenting app. An autism sensory diary that respects you and your child — in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish and Portuguese.

description:

Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

The Pomodoro Technique is a proven time-management framework developed to maximize mental agility and prevent cognitive burnout:

name: Planit: Photo Planner
description:
In this free version, the Ephemeris feature is provided as an in-app purchase. After the purchase, it will be the same as the paid PlanIt Pro. Some screenshots listed here have Ephemeris features enabled. The free version can actually do a lot of things than you thought. It is a plan/marker file reader, a focal length estimator on the map, a DoF and panorama calculator and can even preview the aerial view for your drone. The Ephemeris feature is so highly integrated that it is hard for us to provide some of them in the free version and ask you to pay for the rest. You can see how many users give us a one-star rating simply because we didn't provide a trial. I think that's not fair. But as we said, although we didn't provide a trial, please feel free to purchase to try it. We can refund you at any time if you don't like it.

Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

name: Shoot Planner: Photo Shot List
description:
Plan the shoot before the shoot. Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner and shot list app for photographers and filmmakers — and every part of it works offline.

Most tools do one thing: a moodboard, or a shot list, or a sun calculator. Shoot Planner chains them into one pipeline — references to shots to locations to lighting to storyboard to gear — then follows you into the field on the day.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
The golden hour engine and the field mode are fully on-device. No signal on a canyon rim, in a basement venue, or on a plane means nothing to this app. Your shoot day does not depend on a login screen loading.

SHOT LIST
Build a shot list with priorities, descriptions, focal length and camera notes. Assign shots to a day, drag to reorder, and mark each one captured as you go.

REFERENCES AND MOODBOARD
Collect a visual moodboard per project — shoot with the camera, pull from your photo library, or paste a Pinterest, Instagram or web link and the image and title are fetched for you. Browse it as a masonry gallery and filter by tag.

REFERENCE TO SHOT, IN ONE TAP
Turn any reference into a shot, permanently linked. On set you see the inspiration image beside the shot you are taking — not buried in a different app on a different tab.

GOLDEN HOUR AND BLUE HOUR
An offline solar engine gives sunrise, sunset, the golden hour window with its exact duration, blue hour, and the sun path for every day and location in your plan. No network, no subscription wall, no waiting for a map tile.

LOCATION SCOUTING AND MAP
Geo-tag each shot and see the whole project as numbered pins in shooting order. Save access notes — parking, gate codes, permit restrictions, the walk in — and hand off to your maps app for directions.

STORYBOARD
Lay scenes out as horizontal filmstrips, drag to sequence them, and set per-shot durations with realistic travel and setup gaps between them. See whether the day actually fits before you promise it.

GEAR LIBRARY AND PACKING LIST
Keep a reusable inventory of bodies, lenses, support, power, filters and drone kit. Build a packing list per project and watch the packed progress climb. Stop arriving without the one lens the shot needed.

SHOOT MODE
The reason this is not just another planning document. One-handed, one shot at a time: the current shot with its reference image, a live golden hour countdown, a big capture button, skip and advance, and a place for on-set notes. The screen stays awake. It runs entirely offline and syncs when you are back in service.

TEMPLATES AND REMINDERS
Save any project as a template and reuse it, or start from Wedding Essentials, Location Scout or Brand Day. Set shoot-relative reminders — pack gear two hours before call — and push shoot days to your device, Google or Apple calendar.

WHO IT IS FOR
Wedding, portrait, landscape, brand and commercial photographers. Videographers and filmmakers running their own film pre-production. Solo shooters who plan properly and want the plan in their hand on the day.

BUILT FOR THE WAY SHOOT DAYS ACTUALLY GO
Your shooting schedule slips because the light moved, the location was gated, or the client added a setup. Shoot Planner is built to be edited on the day, not admired the night before. Reorder the shot list in the field, re-check the sunrise and sunset times for the new spot, mark the shots you got, and keep the photo shoot checklist honest as the day changes around you.

PRICING
Free to use, with a capped number of projects. Pro unlocks unlimited projects at $6.99/month or $59.99/year — around 28% off annually — and starts with a 7-day free trial.

Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner, shot list app, photography planner, storyboard tool, location scouting notebook, camera gear checklist and golden hour calculator — the whole shoot day pre-production workflow in one offline app.

Download Shoot Planner and walk onto your next shoot knowing exactly what you came for.

name: PlanIt Earth: VR Photo Planner
description:
For landscape, travel, nature, cityscape, night, time-lapse, star-trail, Milky Way and astro photographers: PlanIt Earth builds on everything we learned from PlanIt Pro and takes previsualization to a whole new level.

Ansel Adams called it previsualization — imagining the final print before the shot is ever taken. Seeing a scene before you travel to it greatly increases the chance of coming home with the photo you wanted. PlanIt Earth is built around that one idea: see the shot before you go.

What sets it apart is the photorealistic VR viewfinder. Instead of reading numbers on a map, you stand at your camera position and see the real terrain — built from satellite imagery and elevation data — with the Sun, Moon, Milky Way, stars, clouds, 3D markers and your framing exactly where they will be. Scrub time and watch light and shadows move through your composition.

There isn't always a signal out in the field. Preload offline elevation, maps and markers, and keep scouting and planning entirely offline.

Plan the light. Preview the scene. Arrive ready.

FEATURES

Photorealistic VR planning

description:

THIS IS THE AD-FREE VERSION OF PHOTOGRAPHER'S COMPANION WITH MORE FEATURES.

- Calculate the best setting for an EV (exposure value) given

- Calculate the print size
- Time lapse
- Planner for landscape photos, from a drone and panorama
- Black and white film developing
- Calculate the reciprocity failure
- Bracketing
- Focus shift
- Tilt lens

- Bellows extension

. Photographic composition (rule of thirds, diagonal, triangle, golden ratio, golden spiral, focal lengths comparison, external viewfinder)

name: Time Calculator Cardamon
description:
Add, subtract, multiply, and divide spans of time, then read the answer in any of 26 formats. Time Calculator by Cardamon is a free time duration calculator for hours, minutes, seconds, and more, with no ads.

Working out a shift minus lunch? Type 8 hours 45 minutes, subtract 1 hour 15 minutes, and get 7 hours 30 minutes. Need to know how long three 50-minute sessions run? Multiply 50 minutes by 3 to get 2 hours 30 minutes. Splitting a 6-hour job across 4 people? Divide 6 hours by 4 to get 1 hour 30 minutes each. This is the hours and minutes calculator for anyone who is tired of doing time math in their head.

Time Calculator works with durations, not clock times. It does not tell you what time it will be or work with calendar dates. It figures out how long, then converts that time span into whatever units you need. Think of it as a time span calculator and a duration calculator rolled into one clean keypad.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Add and subtract time: 2 hours 30 minutes + 45 minutes, or 5 days minus 18 hours. The add and subtract time calculator handles mixed units in a single line.
- Multiply and divide a duration by a number: 25 minutes times 12, or a week divided by 5. Scale any time span up or down in one tap.
- Continue from your last answer: press = and keep typing to build the next calculation on the previous result.
- Read the result in 26 formats: from a single unit like Hours or Minutes, to combined views like Day Hour Minute, up to All Units, from years down to milliseconds.

CALCULATE HOURS THE EASY WAY

Stop converting minutes to decimal hours by hand. Enter your hours and minutes, and the hours minutes calculator does the rest. Total a timesheet, work out hours worked across a week, or check how many hours a project really took. Add overtime, subtract breaks, and read the clean total in the format you prefer. When you need to calculate hours worked fast, the math stays in the app instead of on a scrap of paper.

8 TIME UNITS

Milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years. The millisecond is the smallest unit. Switch the keypad to show either a Milliseconds or a Years key depending on what you work with most, so the units you use live one tap away. Mix any units in one expression and let the duration calculator sort out the totals.

RATE CALCULATOR

Enter an amount and a label, such as 25 and USD, and see the total per hour, per day, per week, and per each of the 8 time units for your current duration. The label is free text, so use it for pay, output, distance, or anything measured over time. Note: this multiplies your amount by the interval. It does not convert currency or fetch exchange rates.

THREE THEMES

Choose System, Light, or Dark. Dark mode is built in and applies instantly, no restart needed. The whole app follows your phone or your preference.

WHO USES IT

- Shift workers and timesheets: total your hours worked minus breaks, then read the result in decimal hours or hours and minutes.
- Freelancers and contractors: add up billable time across tasks and calculate hours for an invoice.
- Payroll and admin: tally shift hours and overtime, then check the weekly total in seconds.
- Cooking and brewing: stack and split timing across steps without losing track.
- Sport and training: add up intervals and rest, then divide a session into even blocks.
- Music and video: add clip and track lengths to find a total runtime.
- Students and teachers: add study sessions or split a deadline into work blocks.
- Anyone who needs clean time math, a quick time span calculator, or a duration calculator without a clock or calendar.

Questions or ideas? Send feedback from Settings and we read every message.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. name: Timelyshot
description:
On 12 August 2026 the Moon's shadow sweeps across Greenland, Iceland and then Spain, from Galicia and Asturias down to the Mediterranean coast and the Balearics: the first total solar eclipse visible from mainland Spain in over a century, and a deep partial one across the rest of Europe. TimelyShot tells you what you will see from the exact spot where you plan to be, and at what time.

THE ECLIPSE OF 12 AUGUST 2026

- Calculate from your exact spot. Tap the map where you actually plan to watch it, not the nearest big city.
- The path of totality drawn on the map, plus how far you are from it. If you are 20 km short, you know before leaving home.
- Local times for every phase: first contact, maximum and last contact.
- Real darkness: the drop in light your eye will actually perceive, not just the fraction of the Sun's disc that is covered. Human vision is logarithmic, so at 99 % of the disc covered there is still plenty of light. The app explains it and also gives you the technical figure.
- Altitude of the Sun above the horizon at maximum. That day the Sun is very low, so a hill or a building can hide the key moment from you.
- Augmented reality: point your camera at the sky and see the Sun's path drawn over the real landscape, exactly where it will be during the eclipse. If something blocks it, you find out now instead of on the day.
- Eclipse animation with a simulated clock and adjustable speed, so you know what to expect minute by minute.
- Countdown and calendar reminder.

And it is not a one-off: on 2 August 2027 totality returns, this time across southern Spain, North Africa and Egypt, and on 26 January 2028 there is an annular eclipse at sunset. The app handles every eclipse in its catalogue the same way, solar and lunar.

THE REST OF THE YEAR

TimelyShot is a planning tool for sun and moon photography.

- Sun and moon alignments: where and when the Sun or the Moon will sit above the landmark, the mountain or the window you choose.
- Sunrise, sunset and golden hour from the exact point you mark.
- Augmented reality to check on site whether your view is clear, without waiting for the day itself.
- Satellite and terrain maps so you can pick your spot properly.
- Cities and landmarks around the world with dates already worked out, for inspiration.
- My alignments: your saved calculations, with filters to find them fast.
- Compass with a calibration warning and a reliability indicator, so augmented reality points where it should.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Choose what you want to see (Sun, Moon or an eclipse) and where from, by tapping the map.
2. Pick a date, or let the app tell you when it happens.
3. The app works out the path, the times and the altitudes.
4. See the result on the map and in augmented reality.

WHO IT IS FOR

Landscape and architecture photographers, amateur astronomers, and anyone who wants to be in the right place at the right time on 12 August.

SAFETY

Never look at the Sun directly, or through your camera, without certified eclipse glasses (ISO 12312-2). Only during the seconds of totality is it safe to look with the naked eye.

An internet connection is needed to calculate. Results are saved in your history.

name: Shotlog: Shooting Logbook
description:
A shooting logbook that keeps score while you shoot. Enter each series as you go, in whole points or tenths, and the total is right before you pack up.

Shotlog is for the club shooter with a paper log or a spreadsheet full of numbers and no easy way to tell whether this winter is going better than the last. Air pistol, air rifle, smallbore, service rifle.

KEEPING SCORE
Add a series and tap in the shots. The running total moves as you go, so the arithmetic is done before you leave the range. If you score in tenths, the decimal keypad takes 10.9 in two taps.

SEE WHETHER YOU ARE IMPROVING
Every session gets its own breakdown: score per series, where your shots are landing, totals. Then look across months of them. Filter by discipline, by tag or by date, so you can put a season of competition results side by side, or read a month of practice on its own. This is the part a paper log cannot do, and it is the reason most people keep logging.

TARGETSNAP
Take a photo of the target, paper or screen, and mark where each shot went. You decide what's a ten. Shotlog reads the score from where you put the marks, then measures the group: mean radius, extreme spread, and how far off centre the group sits on the target face. The ring overlay lines itself up with the photo, so you are not dragging it into position by hand. TargetSnap saves the photo with the session, and you can share the scorecard.

DISCIPLINES
Choose your event and the session sets itself up with the right target face and the right scoring, from the ISSF programme to the national ones for Norway, Germany and the USA. Shotlog remembers the discipline you shot last and opens the next session on it.

YOUR FIREARMS
Keep every firearm in one place, each with its own maintenance log, so you know what was last serviced and when. Link a firearm to a session and it remembers which discipline you shoot with it, so the air rifle and the air pistol each open on their own settings.

PAR TIMER
An interval timer built for shooting sports, with presets or intervals you set yourself. One less app on the bench.

EVERYTHING KEPT
Your log is stored in the cloud, so changing phones does not cost you a season. Tag sessions, add notes, mark a session as practice or competition, and export the lot to CSV whenever you want it somewhere else. Light and dark themes.

RANKS
Logged shots add up to a rank that climbs as you go, which is a fair reason to write up the ordinary Tuesday practice you would otherwise let slide.

Shotlog is free to use, and Shotlog Pro unlocks the full set.

name: Stage Metronome with Setlist
description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

SETLIST FOR YOUR WHOLE SET

Build a setlist before the gig and store each song's tempo, time signature, beat pattern, and accent beats together. On stage, tap a song and everything loads instantly — no sliders, no reconfiguring under pressure. Export the setlist as a file and your bandmates can import the same settings on their own devices in seconds.

A DISPLAY YOU CAN READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM

The beat number is large enough to read from behind a drum kit or across a stage. Full-screen mode shows only the beat number and beat lights — no controls, just a clear visual reference for the whole band. Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. Free, with no subscription required for setlist management.

name: Notion: Music Notation & Tab
description:
Notion is a free, award-winning music composition app for Android on phones, tablets, Chromebooks, and more! You’ll effortlessly compose dynamic sheet music in traditional musical notation or guitar tablature with its intuitive touch-based interface and incredibly broad editing capabilities.

With a user-friendly interface and simple interactive piano keyboard, fretboard, drum pad, and even optional Handwriting Recognition, Notion makes it easy to get started composing your music. You’ll hear your music performed with the most realistic playback possible, using real audio samples recorded by the London Symphony Orchestra at Abbey Road Studios.

Notion is a native cross-platform app, meaning you can write anywhere on any device without requiring a constant Internet connection. And when you’re back online, you’ll be able to sync your work across multiple devices through your preferred cloud provider. Start your work on one device and finish it on another. Once you are happy with your creation you can share the Notion file, or export as MIDI, MusicXML, PDF or as an audio file. You can even optionally transmit scores across a network with other instances of Notion, or between Notion and the Fender Studio Pro DAW.

Compose, edit, and play back your sheet music performed with real piano and orchestral samples recorded by the London Symphony Orchestra at Abbey Road Studios — along with outstanding sampled guitar, bass, drums and other popular instruments. And when you’re ready for more sounds, you’ll find the extensive library of Notion Add-on Soundsets as part of the Feature Bundle. To save space, the initial app download contains just piano — you can then manage which of the bundled Soundsets to have on your device or keep in the cloud, just tap on Sound Installation.

Notion has been featured in various worldwide campaigns and has won several awards, including a prestigious music industry NAMM TEC Award for Best Smartphone/Tablet App.

What you get:
Notion includes unlimited staves, comprehensive editing features and core orchestral and rhythm section Soundsets — all for free. Register to get an additional free Welcome Pack which unlocks an additional Soundset (containing Solo Strings, Classical Saxophones, and Glockenspiel), and the multivoice function that allows writing in up to four voices per staff. Then for the full experience, either sign in with your Fender Studio Pro+ membership or purchase the Notion Feature Bundle. This unlocks Handwriting Recognition, all the Expansion Soundsets (including many auxiliary instruments and additional articulations and effects), additional audio export formats (m4a, OPUS, FLAC) and direct score transfer with Notion and Fender Studio Pro running on the same network.

name: Stage Player (Backing Tracks)
description:
You perform live: music, theatre, dance. On stage, with friends, or in the street.

Sooner or later you wonder whether the phone in your pocket could fire your backing tracks and your sound effects.

If you have tried, you know how it goes. Tracks you cannot arrange in the order you actually play them. Levels all over the place. Dead air before and after every song. Buttons too small to hit under stage lights. And tracks running into each other when they should not.

Stage Player is built to fix exactly that.

Everything gets prepared at home, days before the gig, so that on stage one tap does the whole job.

WHAT IT DOES
• Big pads, laid out the way you play: 6, 9, 12 or 15 to a set
• Trim the silence off a track, set a fade in and a fade out, add a count-in
• Chain one song into the next, with the gap you choose, even across sets
• Sound effects that play over the music, as many at once as you need
• Lyrics that scroll in time with the song, synced to the second
• PDF scores and chord charts that turn their own pages
• Two audio files in one pad, one per ear: a click for you, the band for the PA
• A shared library: prepare a song once, use it in as many sets as you like
• Live mode: everything you cannot need mid-set disappears
• Cloud backup, so a lost phone is not a lost show
• Backup consolidation: the app now checks that your cloud backups went through without a problem, tells you about it, and offers to fix what can be fixed

NOTHING STREAMS
Your files are copied onto the phone. The app never needs a signal to play them, which matters in basements, at festivals, and anywhere the wifi collapses the moment the audience arrives. Airplane mode is welcome.

WHILE THE APP IS OPEN
The screen never goes to sleep, so nothing disappears mid-song. Put the phone on charge for the gig.

FREE
Everything you do on stage is free, and there are no ads. The paid plan only buys more room for cloud backups.

A full manual, with screenshots:
https://www.pragmaticapps.net/help/stage-player

name: Mini Band Exercises
description:
Mini-bands are lightweight, easy to store, and compact—perfect for a workout on-the-go. Even though they are light, themselves, the resistance and results are anything but. You also are not limited to just one muscle group while performing mini-resistance band exercises. You can hit a full body workout on your time, with just a mini-resistance band at your mercy. You can adjust the level of resistance with the different colors of the bands.

Especially if you‘re looking to spice up some bodyweight exercises with a little more difficulty, adding mini-resistance bands to your exercises in different ways can be the modification or variation that you‘ve been searching for. There are tons of mini-band exercises you can do to make sure you hit every muscle in your body.space for at-home workouts, mini bands are going to be a key piece of fitness equipment. And there are tons of mini-band exercises you can do to make sure you hit every muscle in your body.

This is the ultimate guide to resistance loop band exercises – 50 movements you can do with an exercise band to workout your whole body.
You can do these banded exercises at home, in the gym or wherever you want – the resistance loop band is small enough to chuck in your bag and take with you anywhere. Never miss another strength workout.

Using resistance loop bands for strength exercises is an excellent alternative to using free weights or machines.
Bands are super portable so you can just throw them in your bag and have a full strength gym with you wherever you are.

Research shows that strength training with elastics is just as effective as using weights. In fact, using resistance bands has many advantage over weights because they don’t rely on gravity and so can apply resistance to any movement, from any angle.
This makes them super effective for functional strength training or for isolating specific muscle groups. They’re also perfect for doing physical therapy exercises.

Resistance bands are an easy way to introduce yourself to strength training. They are versatile and start at a very low resistance, helping you build your strength. Whether you are recovering from injury or building muscle strength, there are bands for every level of physical strength. As a beginner, you should do these resistance bands exercises one or two times with moderate resistance. Then, as you learn proper technique and understanding of the exercise, you can increase resistance.

Our mini-band workouts will not only strengthen your entire body, but since it’s performed in a circuit fashion—minimal rest between moves—it’ll get your heart pumping, which provides cardiovascular benefits too.

NEURAL MIX™ Stems

Preview and prepare the next song through headphones. By enabling djay’s Split Output mode or by using an external audio interface you can pre-listen to songs through headphones independently from the mix that goes through the main speakers for live DJing.

DJ HARDWARE INTEGRATION

name: Functional Ear Trainer
description:
Ear training can be easy and fun! With a right approach.

Have you (or one of your friends) ever wanted to learn to transcribe or play music by ear?

It is so important for a musician to know what you are hearing. A good musical ear helps when you are composing, improvising, transcribing melodies, or playing with others.

Most likely you have already tried different programs to learn to recognize intervals or even to acquire perfect pitch. However, although such programs develop your ear, but can you actually play any melody you hear as soon as you listen to it?

Imagine you could understand music… It is like when somebody is talking to you, you not only hear pleasant sounds, but you recognize words and their meaning.

One day I came across Alain Benbassat's program called “Functional Ear Trainer” and have been using it ever since. It is based on Alain's ear training method to learn to recognize tones.

The main difference between the Functional Ear Trainer and other methods is that it teaches you to distinguish between tones in the context of a particular musical key. You begin to recognize the role (or function) of each tone in this key, which is incredibly similar to its role in other keys of the same scale.

And it is *guaranteed* anyone can gradually develop this skill. It does not matter:
– who you are – an absolute beginner in music or a virtuoso professional musician;
– how old you are – a 3 yo kid or a 90+ adult;
– what musical instrument you play (you don't even have to play one).

The only requirement is to practice for 10 minutes a day.

I was so excited about this ear trainer that I have developed an Android app based on the Alain Benbassat method. I hope you will find it useful.

Download this app right now, and have fun with your ear training!

name: Sonofield Ear Trainer
description:
Sonofield Ear Trainer (SET) is a revolutionary ear training app designed to help you intuitively play the melodies you hear and imagine. Instead of relying on traditional methods like intervals, SET focuses on helping you feel the unique character of each note within a key. By using sustained drones to create a tonal foundation, you’ll learn to recognize scale degrees based on their *feeling*, not just how they sound.

The app offers a variety of ways to train:
* Degrees Mode - Identify individual notes against the drone by feeling. The heart of SET.
* Melody Mode - Identify short melodic phrases, preparing you for real music.
* Voice Mode - Sing the requested scale degree into your microphone.
* Pocket Mode - Hands-free training for when you're on the go.
* Free Play - An interactive instrument for exploration.

With its intuitive, color-coded interface, thoughtfully designed progression path, and multiple difficulty levels, SET adapts to your skill level while keeping practice engaging. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced musician, SET is your guide to unlocking true musical fluency through intuitive, feeling-based ear training.

No ads or forced payments. The free version contains full foundations for feeling-based ear training. Download the ear training app now!

WHAT’S NEXT

One more helpful cue for your baby’s day.

What’s Next uses on-device AI to turn recent activity logs into personalized timing cues. Depending on what you’ve logged, it may show:

• A likely wind-down window before sleep
• An estimated length for the next nap or sleep
• An approximate wake-up window
• An estimated time for the next feed
• A suggested time to check the diaper

Cues can start appearing after just a few logs. Regular, complete logging helps make them more personal to your baby’s developing routine.

What’s Next is optional. All core tracking features remain free.

GUIDANCE, NOT A SCHEDULE

• Log wet, dirty and mixed diapers

• Keep a diaper log with a clear history of changes

• Track weight, height and head circumference

• Record medications, vaccinations and temperature

CHARTS & REPORTS

• Review daily, weekly and monthly activity charts

SYNC & SHARING

• Sync baby records across multiple devices
• Keep parents, family members and other caregivers up to date
• Track the same baby together without maintaining separate logs

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

Our mission is to help parents gain confidence in the face of the greatest leap in life: having a baby. We take a candid look at parenting, shed light on all sides and are there for all parents. We can all help each other and learn from each other.

Millions of parents before you have already followed, supported and stimulated the 10 leaps in the mental development of their babies. It's not a coincidence that we have been one of the best-selling baby apps worldwide for many years!

name: Elder Care: Pill Reminder Log
description:
Elder Care is a free medicine reminder and personal health record built for older adults and the family members who look after them. Big text, plain words, one-tap answers — and everything stays on your own phone.

NEVER MISS A DOSE
• Reminders at the exact time you set — not "sometime in the next 15 minutes"
• Answer from the notification: "I took it" or "Remind me later"
• Every schedule real prescriptions use: daily, set weekdays, every few days, monthly, every N hours, cycles like 21 days on / 7 off, and as-needed
• Steroid tapers and short courses: the dose steps down on its own and reminders stop on the last day
• "With food / before food / empty stomach" printed on the reminder itself
• Double-dose check: if you already took it minutes ago, the app asks before recording another
• Skip with a reason ("felt unwell", "ran out", "doctor said stop") — the reason goes into your doctor report
• Refill warnings in days, not just tablets — and a warning if a course cannot be finished with what is left
• Reminder health check: send yourself a test alert, and get step-by-step battery fixes for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, OnePlus, realme, TECNO and more

SCAN A LABEL INSTEAD OF TYPING
Point the camera at the box. Name, strength, form and directions are read on the phone — nothing is uploaded — and you check them before saving.

TRACK HOW YOU ARE DOING
• Blood pressure, blood sugar, pulse, oxygen, temperature, weight, breathing, sleep, water, steps
• Pain and mood on a faces scale — no arithmetic while you are hurting
• mg/dL or mmol/L, kg or lb, °C or °F — your choice
• Trend charts with the commonly published range shown for context
• Symptom diary with the medicine you suspect — the app counts and dates them for your appointment, and never claims a cause

KEEP YOUR PAPERS
Photograph prescriptions, lab reports, X-rays, hospital letters and vaccination cards. Search them by the words on the page. Lab values are read off a scanned report and offered for you to confirm — with the range your own laboratory printed.

LAB RESULTS
130 common tests — HbA1c, creatinine, cholesterol, TSH, vitamin D and more — with history and charts per test.

READY FOR THE DOCTOR
• Doctor report PDF: what was taken, what was missed and why, readings, symptoms
• Readings export as PDF or CSV, choose the dates per metric
• Visit preparation: what to mention and what to ask, assembled from your own record
• Family update: a short plain-text message for whoever helps you
• Wallet-sized emergency card with allergies, conditions, medicines and contacts

MADE FOR OLDER EYES AND HANDS
Four text sizes, stronger-contrast mode, dark mode, full-width buttons, no long-press secrets, spelled-out "Required" instead of a tiny asterisk, and every date written out in words.

TWO PEOPLE, ONE PHONE
Keep separate records for yourself and the person you care for, and switch with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server. No analytics. No ads. No subscription. Your record is encrypted on this phone and the key stays in your phone's own secure keystore. Sharing a report, a card or a backup is a file you hand over yourself. Uninstalling removes everything.

Elder Care records what you tell it and shows it back to you. It does not diagnose, dose or replace your doctor or pharmacist.

Free forever. Made with care for the people who need it most.

About Epoch

Epoch Elder Care was founded in 2012, as a home care provider to meet the growing needs for elderly care and services in India. Helmed by Kabir Chadha and Neha Sinha. From 2012 to 2014, Epoch Elder Care focussed on companion care, psychological support & home management in Delhi NCR, Pune and Mumbai.

Over the course of time, our team realized that providing home care was not enough. Many seniors were in need of constant care and supervision, and several had no local family support. name: Anchorly: Dementia Caregiver
description:
Anchorly is a dementia caregiver app for anyone caring for someone living with dementia or Alzheimer's: a fast daily log, a sundowning tracker for the hard hours, medication reminders, and a person-centered life story any carer can read, plus a daily check-in for you, the caregiver. No account, no sign-up wall, and it works offline.

Steady days for them. Support for you.

WHY CAREGIVERS CHOOSE ANCHORLY
• No account, ever. No email, phone number or contacts. The caregiver app is useful in the first 30 seconds, fully offline.
• Private by design. Everything is stored on your phone. There is no server to fail and nothing to leak.
• Honest billing. The daily log, reminders, life story and your check-in are free forever. Cancel Anchorly+ anytime in Google Play, or buy it once.
• Made for tired eyes. Large text, high contrast and calm mode are free for every caregiver.

THE DAILY LOG, IN A TAP OR TWO
• Quick log: sleep, meals, toileting and wandering
• Agitation (calm, restless, agitated) and how the day felt overall
• Good moments: every glimmer is kept; see the latest three or open the full list
• Medications: mark each dose given, with an optional daily "given?" reminder on your phone
Your caregiver log and dementia tracker builds the record of the day while you get on with it.

SUNDOWNING TRACKER
Log a hard moment as Trigger → Behavior → What helped in under a minute, with one-tap suggestions such as hunger, tiredness, noise, reassurance or music. Add the setting and how intense it was. Over weeks, this caregiver journal shows when the hard hours tend to come and what settles them, so every caregiver on the rota knows what works.

KEEP WHO THEY ARE AT THE CENTER
• About them: a short life-story profile in your own words
• Life story: what to call them, what lights them up, what to avoid, anything a new caregiver, a sitter or a memory care team should know
• Calm card: the music, phrases and routines that help during agitation

SUPPORT FOR YOU, THE CAREGIVER
A ten-second daily check-in asks how YOU are doing. Caregiver burnout is real, so Anchorly keeps your own trend next to theirs.

YOUR DATA, YOUR COPY
• CSV export of daily logs, hard moments and good moments, free
• Back up everything to one file and restore it on a new phone, free
• Invite a friend: you both get 30 days of Anchorly+

ANCHORLY+ (OPTIONAL, 100% ON YOUR PHONE)
• Sundowning insights: agitation by hour of day, what usually sets it off, and what helps most, all from your own logs
• Weekly recap: a plain-language summary of what made this week harder or steadier than last week, written from your entries on the device
• Care snapshot PDF: one page with about them, their life story, the patterns and the calm card, to share with family, a respite carer or the care team
• Your caregiver wellbeing trend, and a gentle nudge to take a break after several hard days
• Care for more than one person, and add photos to their life story
Caregiver-friendly pricing: monthly, annual or a one-time lifetime purchase. Cancel anytime in Google Play.

WHO IT'S FOR
Family caregivers, spouses and adult children caring for a parent, and professional caregivers who want a calm Alzheimer's caregiver log. Anchorly is a dementia app for the caregiver, not a brain test or a game.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Anchorly is not medical advice. It does not diagnose, predict, prevent or treat dementia, Alzheimer's or any other condition, and it does not replace a doctor, nurse or care professional. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional about symptoms, medications and care decisions, and call your local emergency number in an emergency.

Feedback? Email dev@adelyons.com. We read every note.

name: Dog Walker & Pet Sitter Log
description:
PawVisit is the record book for a solo dog walker or pet sitter. The client and pet cards, the visit log with a timer, the card you send the owner after a walk, and the weekly invoice. It works offline and your records stay on your phone.

WHAT IT DOES

The visit
Tap the pet, tap start, walk the dog, tap stop. Add a photo and tap what happened as you go: walked, fed, water, peed, pooped, meds given, playtime, let out, litter. The timer is worked out from the moment you started, so locking the phone or taking a call does not lose it.

The visit card
When you stop, PawVisit builds a card: the photo, the pet's name, the date, the start time, how long you were out, what happened and your note. You share it from your own phone through WhatsApp, a text or email, whichever the owner prefers. There is no client app for them to install and nothing is sent automatically.

Clients and pets
Name, phone, address, how to get in, the alarm code, the key tag, the emergency contact and the vet. For each pet: photo, breed, date of birth, weight, medication as the owner gave it, feeding notes, walking notes, and the things you need before you open the door, like pulls on the lead, reactive, never off lead.

One visit can cover several pets from the same household and produces one card for them.

The key ring
Every key you hold and whose it is, sorted by the tag written on the fob. If a key goes missing you can see whose it is in seconds.

Invoices
Bill a client for a week or a month from the visits you completed, at their rate or your standard one. PDF with your own logo. Mark an invoice paid and how it was paid, and see what is owed at 14, 30 and over 30 days. PawVisit does not take payments.

Reminders
Tomorrow's visits, and an invoice still unpaid after two weeks.

Reports
Visits, hours worked and what your completed visits came to, by client, over four weeks to a year. That figure is the value of the work you finished, whether or not it has been invoiced or paid yet. Export to CSV.

Backup
One file with everything in it, photos included. It opens on another Android phone running PawVisit, and restoring adds what is missing rather than replacing what is there.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

PawVisit asks for no location permission at all. It cannot record your route, it cannot see where you go, and there is no map. That is a property of the app, not a setting you have to trust.

There is no account and no sign-up. Your clients' alarm codes and key tags sit on your phone behind an optional app lock that uses your fingerprint, face or device PIN where your phone supports it.

The standard tier shows ads and the app reports crashes so faults can be fixed, so it is not an app that sends nothing at all. What it never sends is anything about where you have been, because it never knows.

WHO IT IS FOR

The one-person dog walker or pet sitter with ten to sixty regular clients who wants the record and the owner update from something built for one person rather than for a team.

The standard tier keeps ten pets, the visit log, the timer and the visit card. Everything you have already recorded stays readable, whatever tier you are on.

CONTACT

https://clearstackapps.com/privacy
https://clearstackapps.com/terms

name: PetVitality Pet Health Tracker
description:
PetVitality is a pet health tracker for dogs and cats, designed by veterinarians and built around what actually gets asked in the exam room: when was the last seizure, how much has the weight changed since spring, which vaccine is due. Nobody can hold all of that in their head. A good pet health tracker holds it for you, and it does the calculating.

Dog and cat health records in one place:

Each pet gets a profile with weight, active medications and the next treatment due on the front page.

What the health tracker follows

* Seizure tracker: log each seizure in under a minute with a timer and video. PetVitality calculates the seizure-free streak, a regularity score and an estimated window for the next seizure. For owners of epileptic dogs, this is the feature that changes how they plan their lives.
* Heat cycle tracker: average cycle, regularity and a forecast for the next heat with a date window you can add to your calendar.
* Weight tracker: quick weigh-ins in kg or lb, food changes marked on the chart so you can see whether the new diet worked, and an evaluation of the trend against your pet's breed and age. Works as a puppy growth chart too.
* Stool tracker and vomiting log: a 1 to 7 stool scale with photos, vomiting frequency with a warning when it clusters.
* Allergy tracker: symptom severity over time, so seasonal patterns become visible instead of remembered.
* Heart rate and breathing rate counter: tap along with each breath or beat, checked against normal ranges for dogs and cats.
* Mood, energy, diary entries, photos and documents, per pet.

Every tracker exports as a PDF. Bring it to the consultation or send it ahead. From the clinic side of the table, a clean seizure log or weight chart changes the quality of the decisions that get made, and that is the standard these reports are built to.

Medication reminder and vaccine tracker

* Vaccines, flea and tick treatments, dewormers and dental care, with the next due date on the front page and a reminder before it lapses.
* Medication reminder with dose schedules and plain-language information about each medicine.
* Routines: walks, feeding, tooth brushing, nail trims and vet visits, as repeating reminders.

For when things go wrong

* Chocolate toxicity calculator using your dog's actual weight and the type of chocolate, with clear guidance for each risk level and a button to call your vet.
* Emergency guides and articles written by veterinarians.

Pet sitter instructions:

Health status, emergency contacts, feeding, medication, exercise, behaviour and house rules, exported as one PDF with your pet's photo on it. This is free for everyone, because a well-informed sitter is better for every pet.

Most veterinary decisions depend on the information the owner brings to the appointment. PetVitality exists to make that information good.

Questions or suggestions: contact@petvitality.io

Vetster’s online veterinary doctors can help with:

- Itchy skin, excessive scratching, or fleas
- Irritated ears: shaking head, scratching, discharge, or odor
- Vomiting, diarrhea, or straining to poop
- Urinary problems: urinating more than normal, straining to urinate, or bloody urine.
- Eye problems
- Breathing issues: coughing, sneezing, or nasal congestion
- Limping, pain, or injury
- Ingestion of something potentially harmful.

Is your Dutch Terrier experiencing fatigue? Does your pet choke on their chewy toy?

Ask a vet your questions and receive peace of mind as well as pet health treatment. Whether you need an emergency vet, pet drugs or medicine from a pharmacy or veterinarian care for an animal species that's not common, the Vetster app can provide professional telehealth help right away.

Using Vetster is simple and convenient:
