name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

Privacy Policy: https://www.askdiem.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.askdiem.com/terms-of-service

name: Food Allergy Scanner - Bokha
description:
Say goodbye to food label stress. Bokha is a simple app that scans food products and helps you review allergens, traces, and additives from the Open Food Facts database.

We've all been there in the grocery aisle, wondering whether a product might contain something problematic. Bokha is designed to help you review product data faster — for yourself, and for everyone you shop for.

With a quick scan, Bokha shows:
• A simple green, yellow, or red indicator based on allergen matches found in the database
• Allergens and traces declared in the product data, including wheat
• A handy history of previously scanned products

Need to check a whole cart? Turn on bulk scan and keep scanning products one after another, without stopping between each barcode.

Shopping for more than one person? Create profiles so each person has their own allergens to detect, scan history, and favorites.

How does it work?
1. Open the app and set the allergens you want to detect — including wheat, gluten, milk, nuts, and more
2. Scan a food barcode, or keep scanning in bulk without interruption
3. Get immediate results showing whether matching allergens are found in database data
4. Switch profiles when you're checking products for someone else
5. Save products you want to revisit

Useful features:
• Fast detection of common allergens, including wheat
• Bulk scan to review many products in a row without interruption
• Multiple profiles, each with their own allergens, history, and favorites
• Clear, color-coded alerts
• Personalized results based on the active profile's selected allergens
• A growing list of products with no matching allergen found in database data
• Easy sharing with family members

Premium gives you:
• Unlimited product scanning
• Bulk scan mode
• Multiple user profiles
• Full scan history
• Detailed additive information
• Unlimited favorites
• More comprehensive product analysis

Bokha connects to Open Food Facts, a collaborative database with thousands of products worldwide.

Bokha is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.
Always verify packaging and ingredient labels before consumption, and consult a qualified healthcare professional for allergy-related decisions.

Terms of Use: https://bokha.app/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://bokha.app/privacy-policy.html

name: Open Food Facts
description:
🔍 Scan, Discover & Compare Over 4 Million Food Products


The app allows to scan the 4 million products already contained in the free and open database Open Food Facts.
The app is collaborative. If we don't have the product, you can add pictures and data to get the Nutri-Score and NOVA score on food processing.

In short, we're kind of "the Wikipedia of food", as many have nicknamed the project. Open Food Facts has enabled the creation of over 100 apps like Date Limite, Yuka or FoodVisor.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

🌍 Join Our Mission for Food Transparency



➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.
➜ You can start contributing today by adding a product from your fridge.
➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts


➜ Milk, Gluten, Eggs, Soybeans, Nuts, Fish, Celery, Mustard, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites, Peanuts, Sesame seeds, Crustaceans, Molluscs or Lupin allergy ?
➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.
➜ Be careful that the information may not be 100% accurate, and detection may not be 100% accurate. So always double check by yourself, with the packaging.

💰 Open Prices: Transparency on Food Costs


- Contribute to Price Transparency. When you shop, add the price on the shelf, or at home, add the receipt. Let's track shrinkflation, cheapflation & more.

💄🧴🐶 More Than Just Food: Scan All Your Products


Open Beauty Facts: Scan cosmetics and hygiene products. You can check for ingredients you want to avoid by setting up "ingredient bans" to get personalized alerts.

Open Pet Food Facts: Find information on food for your furry friends.

Open Products Facts: Discover information on all other products (e.g., electronics, toys, clothes). This database helps you make more circular choices and increase the life of your products.

🌐 Open Food Facts: More Than An App


Open Food Facts is also available on the web at openfoodfacts.org
Feedback : mobile@openfoodfacts.org

After years of doing the same research over and over, I had one thought:

No mystery ratings.

TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS.

name: Gluten Free Scanner
description:
Gluten Free Scanner is a food barcode scanner that tells you in seconds whether a food is gluten free. When it isn't, the result tells you why.

Built for people with coeliac disease (celiac disease in the US) and gluten intolerance, whether you're shopping for yourself or for someone else.

- Instant: point the barcode scanner at any product and get your answer before you put the box down
- Millions of products: more added every day
- Free to download and scan: no account, no sign-up, unlimited scans
- Six languages: English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Spanish
- Works offline: our verdict database, downloaded to your phone
- Scan history: every result you scan, saved for next time

It names the ingredient
A red light is only half an answer. When a product contains gluten, this ingredient checker names the one responsible, wherever the database has that detail, so you start spotting the usual suspects on labels yourself.

Just diagnosed?
The first weeks of a gluten free diet are a crash course. What has gluten in it? Is soy sauce gluten free? Which beer can you still drink? The app answers those questions while you find your feet, so the grocery shop stops feeling like an exam.

Missing product? Get an answer anyway
Sooner or later you'll scan something the app hasn't seen before. Photograph the barcode, the name, and the ingredients list, and often you'll have a verdict while you're still in the aisle. If it needs a human eye, we review it, and your addition is there for the next person who picks up that product.

Offline mode (Premium)
Supermarket dead spots, basement aisles, flights. Download the database once over Wi-Fi and the food scanner carries on with no signal at all; it refreshes itself the next time you open the app online. It packs well, too: scan your way round a supermarket abroad with mobile data switched off.

Scan history (Premium)
Every result is saved, so you look a product up once and the answer is waiting next week. No more trying to remember which brand it was that passed.

Share what you find
Scanning for a child, a partner, or a friend? Share a product's result in one tap, so everyone doing the shopping sees the same answer.

For every gluten free shopper
Coeliac disease, non-coeliac gluten sensitivity, a gluten intolerance, or a coeliac friend coming to dinner: the question in the aisle is the same. Is it gluten free? Scan snacks, cereals, bread, pasta, sauces, chocolate, and drinks on the weekly grocery shop, and get a straight answer on each one.

A note on gluten
Gluten comes from wheat, barley, rye, spelt, and triticale. On a label it hides behind names like barley malt, malt extract, wheat starch, and hydrolysed wheat protein, and it turns up where you least expect it: soy sauce, stock cubes, soups, sweets, and beer. The app reads the ingredients and warnings recorded for a product and flags the ones that mean gluten, including "may contain" and shared-facility warnings where they're recorded, so you're not decoding every label on your own. It can only read what's on record for a product, so always check the packaging, and talk to your doctor about managing coeliac or celiac disease. Gluten Free Scanner is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.

Install it before your next shop and try it on whatever's in the cupboard.

Scan smarter and stay gluten free with Gluten Free Scanner: GF Foods, your essential food scanner, label checker, and product analyzer for managing gluten free diets, celiac disease, and food intolerance.

This app helps you scan food labels, check ingredients, and analyze products for potential gluten content. Whether you are shopping, tracking your diet, or trying to eat healthy and clean, Gluten Free Scanner makes products easier to understand.

Gluten Free Scanner works as a smart label scanner and product checker. Simply scan a product using your camera or barcode and analyze ingredients in seconds. The app helps identify gluten-related ingredients, highlights allergens, and supports safer food choices.

Food labels can be complex and unclear. With built-in OCR and machine learning support, the app reads ingredient labels and converts them into readable text. It then analyzes ingredient lists for gluten indicators such as wheat, barley, rye, and related derivatives using smart matching logic.

Use this app as your daily food checker, ingredient analyzer, and healthy eating assistant. It supports better decisions for gluten free, low, and clean eating.

Built for gluten free and celiac users, the app focuses on ingredient-based gluten analysis and allergen awareness. It can also help identify other allergens such as peanut and dairy, supporting multiple dietary needs.

Gluten Free Scanner includes optional low FODMAP support. The app scans ingredient text and matches it against a large list of high FODMAP ingredients such as certain fruits, vegetables, polyols, and grains. This feature is based on keyword matching and is not a certified FODMAP database.

This is not just a barcode scanner. It is a product checker and food tracker that analyzes ingredient data from both barcode sources and scanned labels, helping you compare and evaluate food products.

Use Gluten Free Scanner while shopping to check labels, compare products, and make more informed decisions. It supports healthy, clean, and gluten-free living by helping you better understand ingredients and avoid unwanted content.

You can create profiles for yourself or your family and adjust preferences based on gluten sensitivity levels, making it easier to manage food choices.

Features include gluten free scanner, food label scanner, barcode product checker, ingredient checker, allergen detection, low FODMAP matching, food tracker, clean eating support, and fast scanning.

- What is coeliac/celiac disease? -

Coeliac/celiac disease is not an allergy or an 'intolerance'. It is a life-long condition where the immune system reacts abnormally to the protein, gluten, causing damage to the small
intestine. Physical symptoms of ingesting gluten are not immediate and may take longer to present.

- What is gluten? -

Gluten is the generic name for the protein found in the following grains and their derivatives:
• Barley (including malt)
• Rye
• Oats
• Wheat (including einkorn, triticale, spelt)

- What is the treatment? -

There is no cure for coeliac/celiac disease. A strict and life-long gluten free diet is currently the only medical treatment for people living with coeliac/celiac disease. Even with mild symptoms changing to a gluten free diet is advised to avoid serious complications. An increase in the range of available gluten free foods in recent years has made it possible to eat both a healthy and varied gluten free diet.

- What is a gluten free diet? -

A gluten free diet is an eating plan that excludes foods containing gluten and is essential for managing signs and symptoms of coeliac/celiac disease and other medical conditions associated with gluten.

- What happens if a person with coeliac/celiac disease eats gluten? -

The reaction to eating gluten varies depending on the amount of gluten consumed and the individual’s typical symptoms. People may experience some or all of the following physical symptoms:
• Nausea and/or vomiting
• Diarrhoea and/or constipation
• Fatigue, weakness and lethargy
• Cramping and bloating
• Irritability and other abnormal behaviour

Symptoms may develop any time up to 48 hours after ingestion. The reaction may be fairly mild or quite severe. Some people will have no obvious reaction. It’s important to remember that damage to the intestine can still occur despite the absence of symptoms.

name: Baby Meals: 3-Day Allergy Log
description:
Which food did you try first, and how did your baby react that day?
Starting solids is a lot to keep in your head. Baby Meals logs the meals and
watches every new food for three days so you do not have to remember.

■ Three days of watching for every new food
Save a meal that contains a food your baby has never had, and the three day watch
starts right there. From the next day on, one box a day: just mark whether anything
happened. Three quiet days and the food moves up to Safe. One symptom and it is
marked Allergic straight away.
Symptoms you can tag: Rash, Vomiting, Diarrhea, Hives, Other.

■ Ingredient library
94 foods commonly used for weaning are already in the app, from rice and beef to
broccoli, apple and pumpkin. They are sorted into Grains, Meat, Seafood, Vegetables,
Fruit, Dairy, Legumes and Other, and every food carries one of four states:
Not tried, Watching, Safe, Allergic.
31 of them are common allergens such as wheat flour, milk, peanut and shrimp, and
they are flagged so you look twice before the first spoonful. Anything missing from
the list you can add yourself.

■ Meal log
Date and time, weaning stage, the foods, how much was eaten and how your baby reacted.
One photo per meal, plus a note if you want.
The stage follows your baby's birthday and moves through Early, Middle, Late and Final
on its own, or you can set it yourself.
Pick a food already marked Allergic and the app tells you before it saves.

■ Calendar and stats
Tap any day in the calendar to see that day's meals, and fill in past days you missed.
Stats cover this week and this month: new foods tried, meals logged, the foods your
baby ate well and the ones that did not go down.

■ A reminder so it does not slip
Once a day at the time you choose, if a food is still being watched.
Change the time or turn it off whenever you like.

■ Everything stays on this device
No account, no sign in. What you write stays on the device and is never sent to a
server. It works the same with no connection at all.

■ Premium (one time purchase)
No ads
Multiple babies
CSV export
Home screen widget

The app follows your system theme, or you can pick light or dark yourself.

The guidance in this app is based on general information about starting solids.
If you see allergy symptoms in your baby, please see your pediatrician.

name: Histamine Tracker: Food Diary
description:
Struggling with histamine intolerance? Fatigue, bloating, brain fog, flushing, anxiety -- if you've spent years dealing with symptoms like these without answers, you're not alone.

Histamine Tracker is a food diary and symptom tracker designed for people with histamine intolerance, MCAS, and food sensitivities. It surfaces patterns in your logged data -- connecting what you ate hours earlier to how you feel later -- so you can explore observations you might otherwise miss.

SCAN FOOD WITH YOUR CAMERA
Point your phone at any meal, menu, or ingredient label and instantly see its histamine level. No searching, no typing — just snap and know what you're dealing with.

TRACK MEALS, SYMPTOMS & SUPPLEMENTS
Log meals, symptoms, supplements, and activities naturally. Just type what you ate or how you feel -- no tedious dropdowns or calorie counting.

AI-POWERED DAILY FINDINGS
Generate a daily summary of your logged entries. AI finds patterns in your own data — connecting meals logged hours earlier to symptoms you noticed later — and suggests observations worth exploring.

1,000+ FOODS RATED BY HISTAMINE LEVEL
Browse a comprehensive histamine food list organized by category. Every food is rated Low, Moderate, or High histamine so you can make more informed choices on your low histamine diet. Includes notes on DAO blockers, histamine liberators, and common triggers.

EXPAND YOUR ELIMINATION DIET WITH CONFIDENCE
Many people with histamine intolerance eliminate too many foods unnecessarily. Your food diary data helps surface which foods may be worth reintroducing, so you can expand your elimination diet with more confidence instead of restricting forever.

SET GOALS, GET PERSONALIZED INSIGHTS
Tell the app which foods you want to avoid (dairy, gluten, alcohol, aged cheese, and more), your ideal sleep schedule, and your wellness goals. Every finding is based on your own food log entries and personal intentions.

ASK AI ABOUT ANY FOOD
Wondering if a food is safe on a low histamine diet? Snap a photo or type any meal or ingredient and get an instant histamine insight -- no searching required.

SHARE WITH YOUR DOCTOR OR NUTRITIONIST
Export your full food journal and daily findings in a clean format you can paste into an email or bring to an appointment. Give your health practitioner real data instead of trying to remember what you ate.

LOW-HISTAMINE MEAL IDEAS & ARTICLES
Browse curated low-histamine meal ideas by category and read articles about managing histamine intolerance, mast cell activation, DAO supplements, elimination diets, and feeling better day to day.

BUILT BY SOMEONE WHO LIVES WITH HISTAMINE INTOLERANCE
After years of struggling with histamine intolerance, insomnia, and chronic pain, I worked with nutritionists, therapists, and sleep specialists to understand how food, sleep, stress, and daily habits affect my symptoms. What I kept wishing for was a simple way to track everything together. So I built it. I use Histamine Tracker every day, and I hope it helps you too.

PERFECT FOR
- Histamine intolerance & HIT
- Mast cell activation syndrome (MCAS)
- DAO deficiency
- Food sensitivities & allergies
- Elimination diets (low histamine, FODMAP, AIP)
- Anyone tracking how food affects how they feel

Histamine Tracker is for informational and personal tracking purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Not a substitute for professional medical advice.

name: NutriSpy: Food & Symptom Diary
description:
NutriSpy is a food diary that finds what sets off your symptoms. A symptom that keeps coming back, a bad gut day, an afternoon with no energy — and no idea what caused it. Log what you eat, how you slept and how you feel, and NutriSpy puts it all on one timeline and shows you likely triggers. Verifiable from week one, in your own days.

Make sense of your symptoms

Complaints often trail their trigger by hours, so memory alone rarely finds the connection. NutriSpy records meals and symptoms with their times and shows which habits and foods go with your better and worse days — more fat in the evening, a shorter night, fewer steps — what settles your digestion, and what leaves you drained. It is honest about how strong each pattern is — a hunch is labelled a hunch.

A food diary that fits your life

Log meals, symptoms, bowel movements, sleep, activity and supplements by voice, photo, barcode or text — one sentence is enough, NutriSpy structures it. Sleep and workouts sync from Apple Health or Health Connect, so your diary fills itself while you live your day.

See what actually helps you

Whether you want to calm your digestion, get to the bottom of a symptom, have more energy or sleep better, NutriSpy shows which foods and habits help and which hold you back. Your daily form tells you at a glance how the day is going, and a coach tip tells you what to try next. Want to lose weight or build muscle instead? Calories, protein and your weight trend sit side by side, with a calorie target that follows your goal. Full nutrient data sits underneath: calories, macros, fiber, vitamins, minerals, omega-3/6 and supplements. Fiber is counted under every meal, soluble and insoluble separately.

Find your triggers

NutriSpy connects nutrition, digestion, symptoms, sleep, activity and cycle, and highlights the relationships that matter for you — "your bloating tends to follow high-fat evenings", not generic averages. A bowel movement or a symptom takes seconds to log and becomes part of the picture instead of another chore.

No pressure to be perfect

You don't have to log everything, every day. Miss a day and your insights still work — this food diary is built for real life, not streaks. Share your log with your doctor or coach whenever it helps.

Free food diary, Premium insights

The food diary is free, AI logging included: meals, symptoms, bowel movements, sleep and supplements by voice, photo or text, with calories and macros. Premium adds the insights: which foods and habits go with your symptoms, the full nutrient and FODMAP analysis with lactose, fructose and the polyols, six months of sleep trends, a coach tip on every entry, sync back to your health app, and a CSV or PDF report for your doctor. For IBS, food intolerance, histamine or heartburn, that makes your food log a symptom tracker. Prices in the app.

Important: NutriSpy is not a diagnostic tool and should not be used for medical diagnoses, treatments, or as a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult qualified healthcare professionals for health concerns or medical decisions.
